# Freelance Scope Change Estimator

## Purpose
Make scope changes visible before work proceeds, reducing unpaid additions and misunderstandings.

## Workflow
1. Collect the accepted scope, exclusions, change-control terms, current status, and exact new request.
2. Compare the new request requirement by requirement with the agreed deliverables.
3. Classify each item as included, clarification, defect correction, dependency, or new scope; mark uncertain items for client confirmation.
4. Estimate incremental effort as a range using user-provided analogs and assumptions.
5. Identify effects on milestones, dependencies, acceptance criteria, risk, and other work.
6. Calculate a draft change estimate only from explicit rates, fees, and hours; leave missing values UNKNOWN.
7. Prepare a change-request document and client message draft; do not start the added work until the user has approval.

## Output
Scope comparison, classification, assumptions, effort and cost range, schedule impact, open questions, and change-request draft.

## Safety and limits
- Do not reinterpret contract terms as legal advice; recommend qualified review for disputes or material contract issues.
- Never invent rates, deadlines, approvals, or prior agreements.
- Do not send messages, modify tickets, change contracts, or begin work.
- No paid tools or APIs. No runtime activation or tool grants.

CEOAI-authored workflow. Analysis and drafting only.
